mentions.name: OneBusAway transit API server
mentions.description: A new transit API server from the OneBusAway project; a blog post walks through the basics of setting it up with Bay Area transit data, with operator data for other locations available via Transit.land.
mentions.source_excerpt: If you want to explore our new transit API server, I wrote up a blog post a couple months ago to walk you through the basics: https://opentransitsoftwarefoundation.org/2026/04/setting-up-maglev-bay-area-transit-data/
